response.overview: The story of the voraciously hungry zoo lion who eats everything he can, telling how Balthazar learns his lesson when he eats the moon and has terrific indigestion. Animated, no narration., Presents an animated world of the zoo constructed of simple, everyday materials. Includes the story of lion Balthazar as the single dissonant element whose ambition is to devour everything within reach, including the moon. Shows how finally, order is restored and the zoo is peaceful again.
response.title: Balthazar The Lion
